findings.claim: A refreshed solved-run record (since withdrawn from the working tree) claimed 'the export's LAB_BUNDLE.sha256 hashed 675a6a96...', but that digest was the sha256 of the lab's README.md at commit b1d7c974, pasted in place of the bundle hash; the javascript-fundamentals record repeated the same error with 466d633a....
findings.recommendation: Re-run the solved-run procedure on final bytes and record the sha256 of the export's LAB_BUNDLE.sha256 manifest file itself; never derive the value from a per-file entry.

items.note: Both solved-run records are byte-identical to their committed state; the impossible duplicated LAB_BUNDLE.sha256 claims are gone from the working tree, and the recomputation plan (sha256 of the export's LAB_BUNDLE.sha256 manifest file) matches the original records' meaning.
